pr_title: GameEngine: close ADR 0121 first-release parity gaps
pr_body:
## Summary

Re-audits ADR 0121 on current main and closes the remaining first-release semantic parity gaps. Material and Project Settings live Editor mutations create undoable history through the existing shared typed-document service. Regression coverage compares direct Editor semantics, registry-driven generic MCP, domain MCP tools, and CLI for Material, Project Settings, and Animation Set.

This revision also fixes the validation findings from superseded Draft PR #186: Material undo helpers use Path rather than PathBuf references, and Material parity fixtures are canonicalized through the persisted JSON boundary so all adapters receive identical typed values.

## Compatibility

No persisted schema, Stable ID, capability ID, public tool name, ProjectRoot confinement rule, or MCP lifecycle contract changes. MCP remains Editor-attached and is not a competing file writer.

## Validation

Run Windows Validation in affected mode for engine-editor. Visual Validation is not required because no UI layout or appearance is changed.
